1.1: Hashshuttafin sheratzu laasot mechitztza bechatzer, bonin et hakkotel baemtza. mekom shennahagu livnot gavil, gazit, kefisin, levenim, bonim, hakkol keminhag hammedina. begavil, ze noten shelosha tefachim, veze noten shelosha tefachim. begazit, ze noten tefachayim umechetza, veze noten tefachayim umechetza. bichfisin, ze noten tefachayim, veze noten tefachayim. bilvenim, ze noten tefach umechetza, veze noten tefach umechetza. lefichach im nafal hakkotel, hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem:
1.2: Vechen beginna, mekom shennahagu ligdor mechayyevin oto. aval bevika, mekom shennahagu shello ligdor en mechayyevin oto, ella im rotze kones letoch shello uvone, veose chazit mibbachutz. lefichach im nafal hakkotel, hammakom vehaavanim shello. im asu middaat shenehen, bonin et hakkotel baemtza, veosin chazit mikkan umikkan. lefichach im nafal hakkotel, hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem:
1.3: Hammakkif et chavero mishshelosh ruchotav, vegadar et harishona veet hashsheniyya veet hashshelishit, en mechayyevin oto. rabbi yose omer, im amad vegadar et harviit, megalgelin alav et hakkol:
1.4: Kotel chatzer shennafal, mechayyevin oto livnoto ad arba ammot, bechezkat shennatan, ad sheyyavi reaya shello natan. mearba ammot ulemala, en mechayyevin oto. samach lo chotel acher, af al pi shello natan alav et hattikra, megalgelin alav et hakkol, bechezkat shello natan, ad sheyyavi reaya shennatan:
1.5: Kofin oto livnot bet shaar vedelet lechatzer. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol hachatzerot reuyot levet shaar. kofin oto livnot lair choma udelatayim uveriach. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol haayarot reuyot lechoma. kamma yehe vair vihe cheanshe hair, shenem asar chodesh. kana vah bet dira, hare hu cheanshe hair miyyad:
1.6: En cholkin et hechatzer, ad sheyyehe arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze. velo et hassade, ad sheyyehe vah tisha kabbin laze vetisha kabbin laze. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyehe vah tishat chatzae kabbin laze vetishat chatzae kabbin laze. velo et hagginna, ad sheyyehe vah chatzi kav laze vachatzi kav laze. rabbi akiva omer, bet rova. velo et hatteraklin, velo et hammoran, velo et hashshovach, velo et hattallit, velo et hammerchatz, velo et bet habbad, ad sheyyehe vahen kede laze uchede laze. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyechalek ushemo alav, cholkin. veim lav, en cholkin. ematay, bizman sheen shenehem rotzim. aval bizman sheshshenehem rotzim, afillu vefachot mikkan, yachaloku. vechitve hakkodesh, af al pi sheshshenehem rotzim, lo yachaloku:

2.1: Lo yachpor adam bor samuch levoro shel chavero, velo shiach, velo meara, velo ammat hammayim, velo nivrechet kovsin, ella im ken hirchik mikkotel chavero shelosha tefachim, vesad besid. marchikin et haggefet veet hazzevel veet hammelach veet hassid veet hasselaim mikkatlo shel chavero shelosha tefachim, vesad besid. marchikin et hazzeraim, veet hammacharesha, veet me raglayim min hakkotel shelosha tefachim. umarchikin et harechayim shelosha min hashshechev, shehen arbaa min harachev. veet hattanur, shelosha min hakkilya, shehen arbaa min hassafa:
2.2: Lo yaamid adam tannur betoch habbayit, ella im ken yesh al gabbav gova arba ammot. haya maamido vaaliyya, tzarich sheyyehe tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim. uvakkira, tefach. veim hizzik, meshallem ma shehizzik. rabbi shimon omer, lo amru chol hashshiurin haellu, ella sheim hizzik, patur milleshallem:
2.3: Lo yiftach adam chanut shel nachtomin veshel tzabbain tachat otzaro shel chavero. velo refet bakar. beemet, beyayin hittiru, aval lo refet bakar. chanut shebbechatzer, yachol limchot beyado velomar lo, eni yachol lishon mikkol hannichnasin umikkol hayyotzin. aval ose chelim, yotze umocher betoch hashshuk, aval eno yachol limchot beyado velomar lo, eni yachol lishon, lo mikkol happattish, velo mikkol harechayim, velo mikkol hattinokot:
2.4: Mi shehaya chatlo samuch lechotel chavero, lo yismoch lo chotel acher, ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot. vehachallonot, millemalan umillemattan, umikkenegdan, arba ammot:
2.5: Marchikin et hassullam min hashshovach arba ammot, kede shello tikpotz hannemiyya, veet hakkotel min hammazchila arba ammot, kede sheyyehe zokef et hassullam. marchikin et hashshovach min hair chamishshim amma. velo yaase adam shovach betoch shello, ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach. rabbi yehuda omer, bet arbaat korin, melo sheger hayyona. veim lekacho, afillu vet rova, hare hu vechezkato:
2.6: Nippul hannimtza vetoch chamishshim amma, hare hu shel baal hashshovach. chutz mechamishshim amma, hare hu shel motzo. nimtza ven shene shovachot, karov laze, shello. karov laze, shello. mechetza al mechetza, shenehem yachaloku:
2.7: Marchikin et hailan min hair esrim vechamesh amma, uvecharuv uveshikma chamishshim amma. abba shaul omer, kol ilan serak, chamishshim amma. im hair kadma, kotzetz veeno noten damim. veim hailan kadam, kotzetz venoten damim. safek ze kadam, safek ze kadam, kotzetz veeno noten damim:
2.8: Marchikin goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma. lo yaase adam goren kavua betoch shello, ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach, umarchik minnetiotav shel chavero uminniro, kede shello yazzik:
2.9: Marchikin et hannevelot veet hakkevarot veet habburseki min hair chamishshim amma. en osin burseki ella lemizrach hair. rabbi akiva omer, lechol ruach hu ose, chutz mimmaaravah, umarchik chamishshim amma:
2.10: Marchikin et hammishra min hayyarak, veet hakkereshin min habbetzalim, veet hachardal min haddevorim. rabbi yose mattir bachardal:
2.11: Marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma, uvecharuv uveshikma, chamishshim amma, ben milmala ben min hatztzad. im habbor kadam, kotzetz venoten damim. veim ilan kadam, lo yakotz. safek ze kadam, vesafek ze kadam, lo yakotz. rabbi yose omer, af al pi shehabbor kodemet lailan, lo yakotz, shezze chofer betoch shello, veze notea betoch shello:
2.12: Lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero, ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot, echad gefanim veechad kol ilan. haya gader bentayim, ze somech laggader mikkan, veze somech laggader mikkan. hayu sharashim yotzin letoch shel chavero, maamik shelosha tefachim, kede shello yeakkev et hammacharesha. haya chofer bor, shiach umeara, kotzetz veyored, vehaetzim shello:
2.13: Ilan shehu note lisde chavero, kotzetz melo hammardea al gabbe hammacharesha. uvecharuv uveshikma, keneged hammishkolet. bet hashshelachin, kol hailan keneged hammishkolet. abba shaul omer, kol ilan serak, keneged hammishkolet:
2.14: Ilan shehu note lirshut harabbim, kotzetz, kede sheyyehe gamal over verochvo. rabbi yehuda omer, gamal taun pishtan o chavile zemorot. rabbi shimon omer, kol hailan keneged hammishkolet, mippene hattuma:

3.1: Chezkat habbattim vehabborot vehashshichin vehammearot vehashshovachot vehammerchatzaot uvet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin vehaavadim vechol shehu ose ferot tadir, chezkatan shalosh shanim miyyom leyom. sede habbaal, chezkatah shalosh shanim, veenah miyyom leyom, rabbi yishmael omer, shelosha chodashim barishona ushelosha baacharona ushenem asar chodesh vaemtza, hare shemona asar chodesh. rabbi akiva omer, chodesh barishona vechodesh baacharona ushenem asar chodesh baemtza, hare arbaa asar chodesh. amar rabbi yishmael, bamme devarim amurim, bisde lavan. aval bisde ilan, kanas et tevuato, masak et zetav, kanas et ketzo, hare ellu shalosh shanim:
3.2: Shalosh aratzot lachazaka, yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil. haya vihuda vehechezik baggalil, baggalil vehechezik bihuda, enah chazaka, ad sheyyehe immo vammedina. amar rabbi yehuda, lo amru shalosh shanim ella chede sheyyehe veaspamya, veyachazik shana, veyelchu veyodiuhu shana, veyavo leshana acheret:
3.3: Kol chazaka sheen immah taana, enah chazaka. ketzad, amar lo, ma atta ose vetoch shelli, vehu amar lo, shello amar li adam davar meolam, enah chazaka. shemmacharta li, shennatatta li vemattana, avicha mecharah li, avicha netanah li vemattana, hare zo chazaka. vehabba mishshum yerushsha, eno tzarich taana. haummanin vehashshuttafim vehaarisin vehaappotroppin, en lahem chazaka. en laish chazaka benichse ishto, velo laishsha chazaka benichse valah, velo laav benichse habben, velo labben benichse haav. bamme devarim amurim, bemachazik, aval benoten mattana, vehaachin shechalku, vehammachazik benichse hagger, naal vegadar ufaratz kol shehu, hare zo chazaka:
3.4: Hayu shenayim meidin oto sheachalah shalosh shanim, venimtzeu zommin, meshallemin lo et hakkol. shenayim barishona, ushenayim bashsheniyya, ushenayim bashshelishit, meshalshin benehem. shelosha achim veechad mitztaref immahem, hare ellu shalosh eduyyot, vehen edut achat lahazama:
3.5: Ellu devarim sheyyesh lahem chazaka, veellu devarim sheen lahem chazaka. haya maamid behema vechatzer, tannur, vechirayim, verechayim, umegaddel tarnegolin, venoten zivlo vechatzer, enah chazaka. aval asa mechitztza livhemto gevoha asara tefachim, vechen lattannur, vechen lakkirayim, vechen larechayim, hichnis tarnegolin letoch habbayit, veasa makom lezivlo amok shelosha o gavoah shelosha, hare zo chazaka:
3.6: Hammarzev en lo chazaka, veyesh limkomo chazaka. hammazchila yesh lah chazaka. sullam hammitzri en lo chazaka, velatztzori yesh lo chazaka. challon hammitzrit en lah chazaka, velatztzorit yesh lah chazaka. ezo hi challon hammitzrit, kol sheen rosho shel adam yachol likkanes letochah. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh lah malben, af al pi sheen rosho shel adam yachol likkanes letochah, hare zo chazaka. hazziz, ad tefach, yesh lo chazaka, veyachol limchot. pachot mittefach, en lo chazaka, veen yachol limchot:
3.7: Lo yiftach adam challonotav lachatzar hashshuttafin. lakach bayit bechatzer acheret, lo yiftechenna lachatzar hashshuttafin. bana aliyya al gabbe veto, lo yiftachenna lachatzar hashshuttafin. ella im ratza, bone et hacheder lifnim mibbeto, uvone aliyya al gabbe veto ufotchah letoch beto. lo yiftach adam lachatzar hashshuttafin petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon. haya katan, lo yaasennu gadol. echad, lo yaasennu shenayim. aval poteach hu lirshut harabbim petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon. haya katan, ose oto gadol. echad, ose oto shenayim:
3.8: En osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim, borot shichin umearot. rabbi eliezer mattir kede shettehe agala mehallechet uteuna avanim. en motziin zizin ugezuzteraot lirshut harabbim, ella im ratza kones letoch shello umotzi. lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugezuzteraot, hare zo vechezkatah:

4.1: Hammocher et habbayit, lo machar hayyatzia, veaf al pi shehi fetucha letocho, velo et hacheder shellifnim mimmennu, velo et haggag bizman sheyyesh lo maake gavoah asara tefachim. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh lo tzurat petach, af al pi sheeno gavoah asara tefachim, eno machur:
4.2: Lo et habbor, velo et haddut, af al pi shekkatav lo umka veruma. vetzarich likkach lo derech, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich likkach lo darech. umode rabbi akiva, bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu, sheeno tzarich likkach lo darech. mecharan leacher, rabbi akiva omer, eno tzarich likkach lo derech. vachachamim omrim, tzarich likkach lo darech:
4.3: Hammocher et habbayit, machar et haddelet, aval lo et hammafteach. machar et hammachteshet hakkevua, aval lo et hammittaltelet. machar et haitzterubbal, aval lo et hakkelet, velo et hattannur, velo et hakkirayim. bizman sheamar lo, hu vechol ma shebbetocho, hare chullan mechurin:
4.4: Hammocher et hechatzer, machar battim, borot, shichin, umearot, aval lo et hammittaltelin. bizman sheamar lo, hi vechol ma shebbetochah, hare chullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach, lo machar et hammerchatz, velo et bet habbad shebbetochah. rabbi eliezer omer, hammocher et hechatzer, lo machar ella avirah shel chatzer:
4.5: Hammocher et bet habbad, machar et hayyam veet hammammal veet habbetulot, aval lo machar et haachirin veet haggalgal veet hakkora. bizman sheamar lo, hu vechol ma shebbetocho, hare chullan mechurin. rabbi eliezer omer, hammocher bet habbad, machar et hakkora:
4.6: Hammocher et hammerchatz, lo machar et hannesarim veet hassafsalim veet havvilaot. bizman sheamar lo, hu vechol ma shebbetocho, hare chullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach, lo machar et hammegurot shel mayim velo et haotzarot shel etzim:
4.7: Hammocher et hair, machar battim, borot, shichin, umearot, merchatzaot veshovachot, bet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin, aval lo et hammittaltelin. uvizman sheamar lo, hi vechol ma shebbetochah, afillu hayu vah behema vaavadim, hare chullan mechurin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hammocher et hair, machar et hassanter:
4.8: Hammocher et hassade, machar et haavanim shehem letzarkah, veet hakkanim shebbakkerem shehem letzarko, veet hattevua shehi mechubberet lakkarka, veet mechitztzat hakkanim shehi fechuta mibbet rova, veet hashshomera sheenah asuya vetit, veet hecharuv sheeno murkav, veet betulat hashshikma:
4.9: Aval lo machar lo et haavanim sheenan letzarkah, velo et hakkanim shebbakkerem sheenan letzarko, velo et hattevua shehi telusha min hakkarka. bizman sheamar lo, hi vechol ma shebbetochah, hare chullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach, lo machar lo et mechitztzat hakkanim shehi vet rova, velo et hashshomera shehi asuya vetit, velo et hecharuv hammurkav, velo et saddan hashshikma, velo et habbor, velo et haggat, velo et hashshovach, ben charevin ben yeshuvin. vetzarich likkach lo darech, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich. umode rabbi akiva, bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu, sheeno tzarich likkach lo darech. mecharan leacher, rabbi akiva omer, eno tzarich likkach lo darech. vachachamim omrim, tzarich likkach lo darech. bamme devarim amurim, bemocher. aval benoten mattana, noten et kullam. haachin shechalku, zachu vassade, zachu vechullam. hammachazik benichse hagger, hechezik bassade, hechezik bechullam. hammakdish et hassade, hikdish et kullam. rabbi shimon omer, hammakdish et hassade, lo hikdish ella et hecharuv hammurkav veet saddan hashshikma:

5.1: Hammocher et hassefina, machar et hattoren veet hannes veet haogin veet kol hammanhigin otah, aval lo machar lo et haavadim, velo et hammartzufin, velo et haantiki. uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah, hare chullan mechurin. machar et hakkaron, lo machar et happeradot. machar et happeradot, lo machar et hakkaron. machar et hatztzemed, lo machar et habbakar. machar et habbakar, lo machar et hatztzemed. rabbi yehuda omer, haddamim modiin. ketzad, amar lo mechor li tzimdecha bematayim zuz, haddavar yadua sheen hatztzemed bematayim zuz. vachachamim omrim, en haddamim reaya:
5.2: Hammocher et hachamor, lo machar kelav. nachum hammadi omer, machar kelav. rabbi yehuda omer, peamim mechurin ufeamim enan mechurin. ketzad, haya chamor lefanav vechelav alav, veamar lo mechor li chamorcha ze, hare chelav mechurin. chamorcha hu, en kelav mechurin:
5.3: Hammocher et hachamor, machar et hasseyach. machar et happara, lo machar et benah. machar ashpa, machar zivlah. machar bor, machar memav. machar kavveret, machar devorim. machar shovach, machar yonim. hallokeach perot shovach mechavero, mafriach berecha rishona. perot kavveret, notel shelosha nechilin umesares. challot devash, manniach shete challot. zetim lakotz, manniach shete gerofiyyot:
5.4: Hakkone shene ilanot betoch sede chavero, hare ze lo kana karka. rabbi meir omer, kana karka. higdilu, lo yeshappe. vehaole min haggeza, shello. umin hashsharashim, shel baal hakkarka. veim metu, en lo karka. kana shelosha, kana karka. higdilu, yeshappe. vehaole min haggeza umin hashsharashin, shello. veim metu, yesh lo karka:
5.5: Hammocher rosh behema gassa, lo machar et haraglayim. machar et haraglayim, lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane, lo machar et hakkaved. machar et hakkaved, lo machar et hakkane. aval bedakka, machar et harosh, machar et haraglayim. machar et haraglayim, lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane, machar et hakkaved. machar et hakkaved, lo machar et hakkane:
5.6: Arba middot bammochrin. machar lo chittim yafot venimtzeu raot, hallokeach yachol lachazor bo. raot venimtzeu yafot, mocher yachol lachazor bo. raot venimtzeu raot, yafot venimtzeu yafot, en echad mehem yachol lachazor bo. shechamtit venimtzet levana, levana venimtzet shechamtit, etzim shel zayit venimtzeu shel shikma, shel shikma venimtzeu shel zayit, yayin venimtza chometz, chometz venimtza yayin, shenehem yecholin lachazor bahen:
5.7: Hammocher perot lachavero, mashach velo madad, kana. madad velo mashach, lo kana. im haya fikkeach, socher et mekoman. hallokeach pishtan mechavero, hare ze lo kana ad sheyyetaltelennu mimmakom lemakom. veim haya vimchubbar lakkarka vetalash kol shehu, kana:
5.8: Hammocher yayin vashemen lachavero vehukeru o shehuzelu, im ad shello nitmallea hammidda, lammocher. mishshennitmallea hammidda, lallokeach. veim haya sarsur benehen, nishbera hechavit, nishbera lassarsur. vechayyav lehattif lo shalosh tippin. hirkinah umitztza, hare hu shel mocher. vehachenvani eno chayyav lehattif shalosh tippin. rabbi yehuda omer, erev shabbat im chashecha, patur:
5.9: Hashsholeach et beno etzel chenvani ufundeyon beyado, umadad lo beissar shemen venatan lo et haissar, shavar et hatztzelochit veibbed et haissar, chenvani chayyav. rabbi yehuda poter, sheal menat ken shelacho. umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bizman shehatztzelochit beyad hattinok umadad chenvani letochah, chenvani fatur:
5.10: Hassiton mekanneach middotav achat lishloshim yom, uvaal habbayit achat lishnem asar chodesh. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, chilluf haddevarim. chenvani mekanneach middotav paamayim bashshabbat, umemache mishkelotav paam achat bashshabbat, umekanneach moznayim al kol mishkal umishkal:
5.11: Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, bamme devarim amurim, ballach. aval bayyavesh, eno tzarich. vechayyav lehacheria lo tefach. haya shokel lo ayin beayin, noten lo gerumav, echad laasara ballach veechad leesrim bayyavesh. mekom shennahagu lamod baddakka, lo yamod baggassa. baggassa, lo yamod baddakka. limchok, lo yigdosh. ligdosh, lo yimchok:

6.1: Hammocher perot lachavero velo tzimmechu, vaafillu zera pishtan, eno chayyav beacharayutan. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, zerone ginna sheenan neechalin, chayyav beacharayutan:
6.2: Hammocher perot lachavero, hare ze mekabbel alav rova tinnofet lisa. teenim, mekabbel alav eser metullaot lemea. martef shel yayin, mekabbel alav eser kossot lemea. kankannim bashsharon, mekabbel alav eser pitasyaot lemea:
6.3: Hammocher yayin lachavero vehechmitz, eno chayyav beacharayuto. veim yadua sheyyeno machmitz, hare ze mikkach taut. veim amar lo yayin mevussam ani mocher lecha, chayyav lehaamid lo ad haatzeret. veyashan, mishshel eshtakad. umeyushshan, mishshel shalosh shanim:
6.4: Hammocher makom lachavero livnot lo vayit, vechen hamekabbel mechavero livnot lo vet chatnut livno uvet almenut levitto, bone arba ammot al shesh, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer, refet bakar hu ze. harotze laasot refet bakar, bone arba ammot al shesh. bayit katan, shesh al shemone. gadol, shemone al eser. teraklin, eser al eser. rumo kachatzi arko vechachatzi rachbo. reaya laddavar, hechol. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol kevinyan hechol:
6.5: Mi sheyyesh lo vor lifnim mibbeto shel chavero, nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasin veyotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin, veeno machnis behemto umashkah mibboro, ella memalle umashkah mibbachutz, veze ose lo fotachat veze ose lo fotachat:
6.6: Mi sheyyesh lo ginna lifnim migginnato shel chavero, nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasim veyotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin, veeno machnis letochah taggarin, velo yikkanes mittochah letoch sade acheret, vehachitzon zorea et haddarech. natnu lo derech min hatztzad middaat shenehem, nichnas beshaa shehu rotze veyotze beshaa shehu rotze, umachnis letochah taggarin, velo yikkanes mittochah letoch sade acheret, veze vaze enam rashshaim lezarah:
6.7: Mi shehayta derech harabbim overet betoch sadehu, netalah venatan lahem min hatztzad, ma shennatan natan, veshello lo higgio. derech hayyachid, arba ammot. derech harabbim, shesh esre amma. derech hammelech, en lah shiur. derech hakkever, en lah shiur. hammaamad, dayyane tzippori amru, bet arbaat kabbin:
6.8: Hammocher makom lachavero laasot lo kever, vechen hamekabbel mechavero laasot lo kever, ose tochah shel meara arba ammot al shesh, ufoteach letochah shemona chuchin, shelosha mikkan ushelosha mikkan ushenayim mikkenegdan, vechuchin arkan arba ammot veruman shiva verachban shishsha. rabbi shimon omer, ose tochah shel meara shesh ammot al shemone, ufoteach letochah shelosha asar kuch, arbaa mikkan vearbaa mikkan ushelosha mikkenegdan veechad mimin happetach veechad min hassemol. veose chatzer al pi hammeara shesh al shesh, kimlo hammitta vekovreha, ufoteach letochah shete mearot, achat mikkan veachat mikkan. rabbi shimon omer, arba, learba ruchoteha. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol lefi hassala:

7.1: Haomer lachavero, bet kor afar ani mocher lecha, hayu sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim, enan nimdadin immah. pachot mikkan, nimdadin immah. veim amar lo kevet kor afar, afillu hayu sham nekaim amukkim yoter measara tefachim o selaim gevohin yoter measara tefachim, hare ellu nimdadin immah:
7.2: Bet kor afar ani mocher lecha midda vachevel, pichet kol shehu, yenakke. hotir kol shehu, yachazir. im amar, hen chaser hen yater, afillu fichet rova lassea o hotir rova lassea, higgio. yoter mikkan, yaase cheshbon. ma hu machazir lo, maot. veim ratza, machazir lo karka. velamma amru machazir lo maot, leyappot kocho shel mocher, sheim shiyyer bassade bet tisha kabbin uvagginna bet chatzi kav, uchedivre rabbi akiva bet rova, machazir lo et hakkarka. velo et harova bilvad hu machazir, ella et kol hammotar:
7.3: Midda vachevel ani mocher lecha hen chaser hen yater, bittel hen chaser hen yater midda vachevel. hen chaser hen yater midda vachevel, bittel midda vachevel hen chaser hen yater, divre ven nannas. besimanav uvimtzarav, pachot mishshetut, higgio. ad shetut, yenakke:
7.4: Haomer lachavero chatzi sade ani mocher lecha, meshammenin benehen venotel chatzi sadehu. chetzyah baddarom ani mocher lecha, meshammenin benehen venotel chetzyah baddarom, vehu mekabbel alav mekom haggader, charitz uven charitz. vechamma hu charitz, shishsha tefachim. uven charitz, shelosha:

8.1: Yesh nochalin umanchilin, veyesh nochalin velo manchilin, manchilin velo nochalin, lo nochalin velo manchilin. veellu nochalin umanchilin, haav et habbanim vehabbanim et haav vehaachin min haav, nochalin umanchilin. haish et immo vehaish et ishto, uvene achayot, nochalin velo manchilin. haishsha et baneha vehaishsha et balah vaache haem, manchilin velo nochalin. vehaachim min haem, lo nochalin velo manchilin:
8.2: Seder nechalot kach hu, (Bamidbar 27) ish ki yamut uven en lo, vehaavartem et nachalato levitto, ben kodem labbat, vechol yotze yerecho shel ben kodmin labbat. bat kodemet laachin. yotze yerechah shel bat, kodmin laachin. achin kodmin laache haav. yotze yerechan shel achin, kodmin laache haav. ze hakkelal, kol hakkodem bannachala, yotze yerecho kodmin. vehaav kodem lechol yotze yerecho:
8.3: Benot tzelafchad natlu shelosha chalakim bannachala. chelek avihen shehaya im yotze mitzrayim, vechelko im echav benichse chefer. veshehaya vechor notel shene chalakim:
8.4: Echad habben veechad habbat bannachala, ella shehabben notel pi shenayim benichse haav veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem. vehabbanot nizzonot minnichse haav veenan nizzonot minnichse haem:
8.5: Haomer ish peloni veni bechor lo yittol pi shenayim, ish peloni veni lo yirash im echav, lo amar kelum, shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora. hamechallek nechasav levanav al piv, ribba leechad umiet leechad vehishva lahen et habbechor, devarav kayyamin. veim amar mishshum yerushsha, lo amar kelum. katav ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof mishshum mattana, devarav kayyamin. haomer ish peloni yirasheni bimkom sheyesh bat, bitti tirasheni bimkom sheyyesh ben, lo amar kelum, shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, im amar al mi shehu rauy leyarsho, devarav kayyamin. veal mi sheen rauy leyarsho, en devarav kayyamin. hakkotev et nechasav laacherim vehinniach et banav, ma sheasa asuy, aval en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, im lo hayu vanav nohagin kashshura, zachur letov:
8.6: Haomer ze beni, neeman. ze achi, eno neeman venotel immo bechelko. met, yachzeru nechasim limkoman. naflu lo nechasim mimmakom acher, yirshu echav immo. mi shemmet venimtzet deyateke keshura al yerecho, hare zo enah kelum. zikka vah leacher, ben min hayyorshin ben sheeno min hayyorshin, devarav kayyamin:
8.7: Hakkotev nechasav levanav, tzarich sheyyichtov mehayyom uleachar mita, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, eno tzarich. hakkotev nechasav livno leachar moto, haav eno yachol limkor, mippene shehen ketuvin labben, vehabben eno yachol limkor, mippene shehen birshut haav. machar haav, mechurin ad sheyyamut. machar habben, en lallokeach bahen kelum ad sheyyamut haav. haav tolesh umaachil lechol mi sheyyirtze. uma shehinniach talush, hare hu shel yorshin. hinniach banim gedolim uketannim, en haggedolim mitparnesim al hakketannim velo hakketannim nizzonin al haggedolim, ella cholkin beshave. nasu haggedolim, yisu hakketannim. veim amru ketannim hare anu nosim kederech shennesatem attem, en shomin lahem, ella ma shennatan lahem avihem natan:
8.8: Hinniach banot gedolot uketannot, en haggedolot mitparnesot al hakketannot velo hakketannot nizzonot al haggedolot, ella cholkot beshave. nasu gedolot, yisu ketannot. veim amru ketannot, hare anu nosot kederech shennesatem attem, en shomin lahen. ze chomer babbanot mibbabbanim, shehabbanot nizzonot al habbanim veen nizzonot al habbanot:

9.1: Mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot, bizman shehannechasim merubbim, habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu. nechasim muatin, habbanot yizzonu vehabbanim yishalu al happetachim. admon omer, bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon:
9.2: Hinniach banim uvanot vetumtum, bizman shehannechasim merubbim, hazzecharim dochin oto etzel nekevot. nechasim muatin, hannekevot dochot oto etzel zecharim. haomer im teled ishti zachar yittol mane, yalda zachar, notel mane. nekeva matayim, yalda nekeva, notelet matayim. im zachar mane im nekeva matayim, veyalda zachar unekeva, zachar notel mane vehannekeva notelet matayim. yalda tumtum, eno notel. im amar kol ma shetteled ishti yittol, hare ze yittol. veim en sham yoresh ella hu, yoresh et hakkol:
9.3: Hinniach banim gedolim uketannim, hishbichu gedolim et hannechasim, hishbichu laemtza. im amru reu ma shehinniach lanu abba, hare anu osim veochlin, hishbichu leatzman. vechen haishsha shehishbicha et hannechasim, hishbicha laemtza. im amra reu ma shehinniach li bali, hare ani osa veochelet, hishbicha leatzmah:
9.4: Haachin hashshuttafin shennafal echad mehen laummanut, nafal laemtza. chala venitrappa, nitrappa mishshel atzmo. haachin sheasu miktzatan shushevinut bechayye haav, chazra shushevinut, chazra laemtza, shehashshushevinut nigbet bevet din. aval hashsholeach lachavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen, enan nigbin bevet din, mippene shehen gemilut chasadim:
9.5: Hashsholeach sivlonot levet chamiv, shalach sham mea mane veachal sham seudat chatan afillu vedinar, enan nigbin. lo achal sham seudat chatan, hare ellu nigbin. shalach sivlonot merubbin sheyyachzeru immah levet balah, hare ellu nigbin. sivlonot muatin shettishtammesh bahen bevet aviha, enan nigbin:
9.6: Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim veshiyyer karka kol shehu, mattenato kayyemet. lo shiyyer karka kol shehu, en mattenato kayyemet. lo chatav bah shechiv mera, hu omer shechiv mera haya vehen omrim bari haya, tzarich lehavi reaya shehaya shechiv mera, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya:
9.7: Hamechallek nechasav al piv, rabbi eliezer omer, echad bari veechad mesukkan, nechasim sheyyesh lahen acharayut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka, vesheen lahen acharayut en niknin ella vimshicha. amru lo, maase veimman shel bene rochel shehayta chola veamra tenu chevinati levitti vehi vishnem asar mane, vameta, vekiyyemu et devareha. amar lahen, bene rochel tekabberem imman. vachachamim omrim, beshabbat, devarav kayyamin, mippene sheeno yachol lichtov. aval lo vechol. rabbi yehoshua omer, beshabbat amru, kal vachomer bechol. kayyotze vo, zachin lakkatan, veen zachin laggadol. rabbi yehoshua omer, lakkatan amru, kal vachomer laggadol:
9.8: Nafal habbayit alav veal aviv o alav veal morishav, vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov, yorshe haav omrim, habben met rishon veachar kach met haav, baale hachov omrim, haav met rishon veachar kach met habben, bet shammay omrim, yachaloku. uvet hillel omrim, nechasim bechezkatan:
9.9: Nafal habbayit alav veal ishto, yorshe habbaal omrim, haishsha meta rishona veachar kach met habbaal, yorshe haishsha omrim, habbaal met rishon veachar kach meta haishsha, bet shammay omrim, yachaloku. uvet hillel omrim, nechasim bechezkatan, ketubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal, nechasim hannichnasim vehayyotzin immah bechezkat yorshe haav:
9.10: Nafal habbayit alav veal immo, ellu vaellu modim sheyyachaloku. amar rabbi akiva, mode ani vaze shehannechasim bechezkatan. amar lo ven azzay, al hachalukin anu mitztaarin, ella shebbata lechallek alenu et hashshavin:

10.1: Get pashut, edav mittocho. umekushshar, edav meachorav. pashut shekkatvu edav meachorav umekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho, shenehem pesulim. rabbi chanina ven gamliel omer, mekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho, kasher, mippene sheyyachol laasoto fashut. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol keminhag hammedina:
10.2: Get pashut, edav bishnayim. umekushshar, bishlosha. pashut shekkatuv bo ed echad, umekushshar shekkatuv bo shene edim, shenehem pesulin. katav bo zuzin mea deinnun silin esrin, en lo ella esrin. zuzin mea deinnun telatin silin, en lo ella mane. chesaf zuzin deinnun, venimchak, en pachut mishshetayim. kesaf silin deinnun, venimchak, en pachut mishshenayim. darkonot deinnun, venimchak, en pachut mishshetayim. katuv bo milmala mane umillematta matayim, milmala matayim umillematta mane, hakkol holech achar hattachton. im ken, lamma chotvin et haelyon, sheim timmachek ot achat min hattachton, yilmad min haelyon:
10.3: Kotvin get laish af al pi sheen ishto immo, vehashshover laishsha af al pi sheen balah immah, uvilvad sheyyehe makkiran, vehabbaal noten sachar. kotvin shetar lelove af al pi sheen malve immo, veen kotvin lemalve, ad sheyyehe love immo, vehallove noten sachar. kotvin shetar lemocher af al pi sheen lokeach immo. veen kotvin lelokeach, ad sheyyehe mocher immo, vehallokeach noten sachar:
10.4: En kotvin shetare erusin venissuin ella middaat shenehem, vehechatan noten sachar. en kotvin shetare arisut vekabbelanut ella middaat shenehem, vehamekabbel noten sachar. en kotvin shetare verurin vechol maase vet din ella middaat shenehem, ushenehem notnin sachar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, shenehem kotvin shenayim, laze leatzmo velaze leatzmo:
10.5: Mi sheppara miktzat chovo vehishlish et shetaro veamar lo, im lo natatti lecha mikkan vead yom peloni ten lo shetaro, higgia zeman velo natan, rabbi yose omer, yitten. rabbi yehuda omer, lo yitten:
10.6: Mi shennimchak shetar chovo, meidin alav edim, uva lifne vet din veosin lo kiyyum, ish peloni ven peloni nimchak shetaro beyom peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav. mi sheppara miktzat chovo, rabbi yehuda omer, yachalif. rabbi yose omer, yichtov shover. amar rabbi yehuda, nimtza ze tzarich lihyot shomer shovro min haachbarim. amar lo rabbi yose, kach yafe lo, velo yura kocho shel ze:
10.7: Shene achin, echad ani veechad ashir, vehinniach lahen avihen merchatz uvet habbad, asaan lesachar, hassachar laemtza. asaan leatzman, hare heashir omer leani, kach lecha avadim veyirchatzu vammerchatz, kach lecha zetim uvo vaasem bevet habbad. shenayim shehayu veir achat, shem echad yosef ben shimon veshem acher yosef ben shimon, en yecholin lehotzi shetar chov ze al ze velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov. nimtza leechad ben shetarotav shetaro shel yosef ben shimon parua, shetarot shenehen peruin. ketzad yaasu, yeshaleshu. veim hayu meshullashim, yichtevu siman. veim hayu mesummanin, yichtevu kohen. haomer livno, shetar ben shetarotay parua veeni yodea ezehu, shetarot kullan peruin. nimtza leechad sham shenayim, haggadol parua vehakkatan eno farua. hammalve et chavero al yede arev, lo yippara min hearev. veim amar al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze, yippara min hearev. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, im yesh nechasim lallove, ben kach uven kach lo yippara min hearev. vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hearev laishsha bichtubbatah vehaya valah megarshah, yaddirenna hanaa, shemma yaasu kenuneya al nechasim shel ze veyachazir et ishto:
10.8: Hammalve et chavero bishtar, gove minnechasim meshubadim. al yede edim, gove minnechasim bene chorin. hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyav lo, gove minnechasim bene chorin. arev hayyotze leachar chittum shetarot, gove minnechasim bene chorin. maase va lifne rabbi yishmael veamar, gove minnechasim bene chorin. amar lo ben nannas, eno gove lo minnechasim meshubadim velo minnechasim bene chorin. amar lo, lamma. amar lo, hare hachonek et echad bashshuk umetzao chavero veamar lo hannach lo, patur, shello al emunato hilvahu. ella ezehu arev shehu chayyav, halevehu vaani noten lecha, chayyav, shekken al emunato hilvahu. amar rabbi yishmael, harotze sheyyachkim, yaasok bedine mamonot, sheen lecha miktzoa battora gadol mehen, shehen kemayan hannovea. veharotze sheyyaasok bedine mamonot, yeshammesh et shimon ben nannas:
